held_fixed: Provider, model, task, worker count, layer count, action budget, temperature, evaluator, source cap, and bootstrap source set are shared across arms. Only experience routing changes.

validity_gates.target_consistency: All 27 evaluations use Core total 10, all-test total 134, and the frozen collection hash.
validity_gates.model_query_integrity: Every interpreted output has at least one model step and no terminal API error.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: Transfer prompts contain no external Core/all-test scores, failed-test names, or hidden test hash.
validity_gates.reference_count: No-transfer receives zero references; both transfer arms receive exactly three references at every layer.
validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All three frozen sources restore at 10/10 Core, self-report success, and distinct local implementation identities.
validity_gates.prohibited_access: No assistant action accesses benchmark catalogs, hidden tests, or external evaluation paths.

outcome_rule.cross_task_lockin_support: Bounded-recent has one unique primary implementation at both layers 2 and 3 while no-transfer retains at least two at both layers.
outcome_rule.cross_task_boundary: Bounded-recent retains at least two primary implementations at layer 2 or layer 3.
outcome_rule.mitigation_support: Diversity-preserving routing has larger implementation-diversity AUC over layers 2-3 than bounded-recent.
outcome_rule.strong_mitigation_support: Diversity-preserving routing retains at least two implementations at layer 3 without lower mean Core than bounded-recent.
outcome_rule.performance_guard: Report Core, all-test count, input tokens, and latency with diversity. Do not infer net improvement from diversity alone.
outcome_rule.forbidden_claim: A three-layer second-task probe cannot establish universal task generality or long-horizon mitigation.
